name: Sabey Data Centers Ashburn - Building A

source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Sabey Data Centers Ashburn Building A publishes 54 MW of IT capacity. Virginia's state context on this site shows 1,326 MW of published IT capacity spread across 19 facilities that have released a figure, out of 326 mapped facilities total. This campus ranks sixth among those 19 by published megawatts, and its 54 MW represents roughly 4 percent of the published Virginia total. That share is a share of what operators have chosen to disclose, not a share of all capacity in the state, because most mapped facilities publish no figure.

Fifty-four megawatts of IT load is a meaningful quantity for AI workloads. Assuming 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 54 MW supports approximately 1,350 racks, calculated as 54,000 kW divided by 40 kW. At a denser 80 kW per rack, a figure more consistent with current GPU clusters, the same power supports roughly 675 racks. Neither number is the operator's claim; both are illustrative translations of the published megawatt figure using stated assumptions.

The six certifications qualify this campus for specific workload categories. SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 attest to audited controls over financial reporting systems and general security controls respectively. PCI DSS qualifies the facility to host payment card data environments. HIPAA qualifies it to host protected health information. ISO 27001 certifies an information security management system against an international standard. SSAE 18 is the auditing standard under which the SOC reports are issued, not a separate operational certification. No tenant names are published on the operator page this site read.
